pages.text: A forge's level caps how fine a piece it can work, in stars ($(item)★$()):$(li)$(bold)Level 1$(): the basic stations. Up to ★3.$(li)$(bold)Level 2$(): a $(item)Blast Furnace$() and a $(item)Master Anvil$(). Up to ★5.$(li)$(bold)Level 3$(): also $(item)Bellows$() by a furnace, an $(item)Oil Cauldron$() and a $(item)Grinding Wheel$(). Up to ★7.
pages.title: Forge Levels

pages.text: The basic anvil and grindstone also wear on your work: one in ten pieces finished on them spoils, however well you struck it. The Master Anvil and Grinding Wheel never do.
